status: isolated V1 candidate; partial cached research coverage
scientific_boundary: Counts represent Elder Tree evidence available in Earthline data, not the true total number of Elder Trees in nature.
confidence_definition: For modeled candidates, Earthline Confidence is a 60–95 relative structural-evidence index within the analyzed candidate set, derived from the detector's height, emergence, crown and context evidence. It is capped below verified status and is not a probability of age or ancient/veteran status.
